assets.prompt: Repair boss casting sheet for an actual game. Same hulking Greek underworld guardian, black armour, gold trim/barred helmet, violet cape. CRITICAL remove ALL brown/purple background; fully TRANSPARENT RGBA. Exactly SIX columns and FIVE rows with generous empty gutters. ALL SIX frames in each row maintain EXACT SAME facing from windup to release/recovery. Row1 DOWN: helmet/chest face viewer throughout, magic DOWN below chest. Row2 UP: back of helmet and cape throughout, magic UP above shoulders. Row3 LEFT: true LEFT PROFILE in EVERY cell, helmet slit/face/toes point LEFT and cast LEFT of body, never right. Row4 UP-LEFT: REAR-left45 throughout, BACK cape/leftside visible, helmet and arm toward UPPER LEFT, never front/right. Row5 DOWN-LEFT: FRONT-left45 throughout, helmet/chest/arm toward LOWER LEFT, magic below-left of chest. NO right-facing poses. Six fluid stages: windup,gathering,extending,release,follow-through,settle. Head/waist/feet/root/camera size and position fixed within every cell. Single character per cell, attached hands, no ground/shadow/grid/text. Crisp game pixel-art.

Edit this exact transparent6-column5-row priest walking sheet. Preserve characters, poses, pixel style, layout, directions, head/waist position and size, colours and transparency. Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation spritesheet for the original Greek roguelite Paradise in Hell. Reference image is ONLY identity/outfit/style reference: use the named class, correct bad poses, do not copy floating equipment. One transparent RGBA PNG, no floor, drop shadow, scenery, grid, labels, text or watermark. Crisp deliberate low-resolution pixel clusters, strong readable outline, NOT soft illustration. Adult Mediterranean mortal MAN, short dark beard, olive skin. Same head, body proportions, clothes and gear in EVERY cell. Weapons are firmly held in hands as part of the full-body illustration. No detached weapon layers.  Class: Caçador / hunter. ivory tunic, short deep-teal cloak, bronze open-faced crested helmet, leather sandals, ONE wooden recurve BOW held naturally, quiver on back. Use attached WALK sheet as exact identity/outfit/proportions/directions reference, replace gait with these actions. Canvas2048x1280. EXACT invisible grid EIGHT columns and FIVE rows. Row1 DOWN/south: front, both eyes and chest visible. Row2 UP/north: back of head and back of clothing. Row3 LEFT/west: true left profile, face and toes point horizontally LEFT. Row4 UP-LEFT/northwest: true45-degree REAR-left, back and left side visible, body faces UPPER LEFT. Row5 DOWN-LEFT/southwest: true45-degree FRONT-left, BOTH eyes/face and chest visible, shoulders and feet point LOWER LEFT. Row5 must be clearly a FRONT diagonal, absolutely not a side-profile or rear view. Do not draw ANY right-facing rows; engine will mirror.  Each row exactly EIGHT frames: columns1–4 IDLE BREATHING, columns5–8 ATTACK. Columns1–4: feet PLANTED at identical places, head/waist fixed, visibly breathe: neutral chest, inhale, full chest/slightly lifted shoulders, exhale. Cloth subtly expands, no walking, no whole-body bob or sway. Columns5–8: wind-up, attack release, follow-through, recovery of drawing and releasing one arrow with the bow. Attack points in row direction. EXACT same head size, body scale/pivot across ALL8columns, solesy82%, headcenterx50%y30%, waistx50%y56%. No drift or zoom. Front diagonals show face/chest and differ clearly from profile. Equipment stays in SAME anatomical hand in all frames, never swap hands. Exactly ONE of each item. All sprite inside cell. Transparent gutters; no floor/shadow/background/checkerboard/text.
